summary: Reading Room direction: the session as an essay proven in the margin — lowest-density editorial page with marginal evidence numerals binding each tool claim to its note and verification sheet.

claims.claim: Editorial-page-with-marginalia composition keeps the reading column calm at lowest density while withdrawing sidebars to slim rails
Marginal evidence numerals cite every tool claim in place and bind the gutter note to the summoned verification sheet
Warm paper plus summoned glass surface logic with breath motion sustains long-session reading without startling the reader
Calm-reading vs capability tension is resolved by withdrawing capability behind glass one gesture away rather than removing it

decisions.choice: Adopt Territory 3 Reading Room as Direction candidate direction-reading-room with marginal evidence numerals as signature and density-on-demand discipline
rationale: Territory 3 is the only territory that treats sustained reading as load-bearing and spends all density inside expanded notes and summoned sheets
Marginal numerals give session-scoped evidence a citation layout competitors lack, directly serving trust-but-verify
Lowest-density thesis maximizes divergence against control-room and work-order lenses
alternatives: Default the trace to expanded rows under every turn
Hide tool activity behind a single disclosure count
risks: Reads as article not workbench if rails feel distant
Failures need in-place urgency without breaking calm
revisitWhen: Blind critic finds capability signal too weak or failure states too quiet to ship

risks: Calm may read as weak capability if withdrawn rails feel distant at 1440px
Failure urgency must survive without pulse or toast on a quiet ground
Numeral sequences need capping rules or heavy turns overwhelm the margin
